external_entities.name: Malicious Browser Extension
external_entities.description: Browser extension attempting to impersonate legitimate wallets or inject malicious code

ambiguities.text: The specification states DApp listeners must persist for 'page lifetime' without defining what constitutes page lifetime in SPA contexts.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'page lifetime' means until navigation away from the origin or page unload event. SPAs should maintain listeners across route changes.

ambiguities.text: The rdns field 'should reference an active domain controlled by the provider' is not enforced by the protocol.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this is advisory only and DApps cannot verify domain ownership. Treat rdns as a hint, not a security guarantee.

ambiguities.text: The specification doesn't define behavior when multiple providers announce with the same rdns but different uuids.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume DApps should display all providers and let users choose, treating duplicate rdns as potentially legitimate (multiple wallet instances).

implicit_assumptions.description: DApps trust that the EIP-1193 provider returned in EIP6963ProviderDetail is the legitimate provider from the wallet extension.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A malicious extension could substitute a fake provider that steals private keys or redirects transactions.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot inject code that executes before legitimate wallet extensions announce themselves.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A fast-loading malicious extension could impersonate legitimate wallets by announcing first with similar branding.

implicit_assumptions.description: The browser's Content Security Policy allows rendering of data: URIs for wallet icons.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Wallets may appear without icons in high-security environments, degrading UX and making impersonation easier.

implicit_assumptions.description: Users can distinguish between legitimate and impersonating wallet providers based on visual cues.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users may be tricked into selecting malicious wallet impersonators with similar names and icons.
